introHtml: Fleece sweaters and cardigans provide warmth and comfort without the bulk of traditional wool or cotton knits. The brushed polyester or cotton-blend fabric resists pilling and holds up to frequent washing, making it a practical choice for employee uniforms, trade show giveaways, or client appreciation gifts. Choose from full-zip, half-zip, or pullover styles and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish that lasts.
